The lookup was exposed because its requests did not opt out of the offline caching path, so they went through the service worker's default handling. The fix is in `openmrs-esm-patient-management` PR #2638 (commit `e4aacbd5`), under ticket O3-5832. I could not find the service worker's own code in the indexed repositories, so the "reopened Dexie and rescanned dynamic routes" mechanism is taken from the PR text, not verified in source.

**Why it was exposed:** The PR description says patient search "bypasses an expensive per-request Dexie lookup that was unnecessarily slowing things down." Before the change, `useInfinitePatientSearch`, `useRestPatients` and `useRecentlyViewedPatients` all passed bare `openmrsFetch` as their SWR fetcher, with no caching-strategy header. Any such request therefore fell to the service worker's default path, which is the per-request cost the question describes.

**What the requests do now:** At that commit, the three search and recently-viewed fetches use a local `fetcher` that sends `omrsOfflineCachingStrategyHttpHeaderName: 'network-only-or-cache-only'`. Those requests skip the default path. The change is in `packages/esm-patient-search-app/src/patient-search.resource.tsx`, lines 1–25 and the three fetcher call sites in the diff.

**Current state:** The file at HEAD has since changed. Its `fetcher` (lines 8–10) calls `openmrsFetch` with no header, so the header-based version from this commit is no longer present there. I did not trace what replaced it.

**Context:** The framework has since removed the offline service worker. `openmrs-esm-core` keeps `messageOmrsServiceWorker` and `subscribePrecacheStaticDependencies` as no-op deprecated stubs (`packages/framework/esm-framework/src/deprecated.ts`, lines 52–78), so the header now has no caching effect at all.

Evidence, best first:

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-management` commit `e4aacbd5a6242821c4f956230535f598cdeac835` (merge of PR #2638), which adds the caching-strategy header to the search fetchers.
2. PR #2638 in `openmrs-esm-patient-management`: title, body stating the Dexie lookup cost, and linked ticket O3-5832.
3. The commit diff of `packages/esm-patient-search-app/src/patient-search.resource.tsx`.
4. `openmrs-esm-core` `packages/framework/esm-framework/src/deprecated.ts`, lines 52–67, showing the service worker was removed.
5. Current HEAD of `openmrs-esm-patient-management` `packages/esm-patient-search-app/src/patient-search.resource.tsx`, lines 1–25, showing the header-free fetcher.
